design-branding.title: Design & Branding
design-branding.description: Logos, brand guidelines and communication materials that captivate your audience and give your brand a strong, memorable identity.
design-branding.aboutDescription:
Our creative lab designs coherent, impactful visual identities for Cameroonian businesses and institutions. From the logo to the full brand guidelines, every element is crafted to reflect your brand's values and leave a lasting mark on your audience.

We work closely with you, from identity research to the delivery of final files, through several iterations to guarantee a result that truly represents you.
included: Market research and competitive analysis to position your brand
Logo creation, brand guidelines and adaptations for all your materials
Delivery of source files and a brand usage guide
benefits: A professional visual identity that strengthens your company's credibility
Consistency across all your print and digital communication materials
Personalized support at every stage of the project
Deliverables suited to the realities of the Cameroonian market

developpement-web.title: Web & Mobile Development
developpement-web.description: Showcase websites, e-commerce platforms and custom applications: fast, secure and designed to convert your visitors into customers.
developpement-web.aboutDescription:
LaboGraphie designs and builds custom websites and mobile applications, combining technical performance with a polished user experience. Whether you need a showcase site, an online store or a business application, our team supports you from A to Z.

We use modern, robust technologies to guarantee fast, secure and scalable solutions, suited to connectivity and usage realities in Cameroon.
included: Needs analysis and UX/UI design tailored to your users
Front-end and back-end development with modern technologies
Testing, deployment and training on how to manage your platform
benefits: A fast, secure and responsive website or application
A user experience designed to convert your visitors into customers
Technical support after launch
Scalable solutions that grow alongside your business

cybersecurite.title: Cybersecurity
cybersecurite.description: Audits, penetration testing and protection solutions against cyber threats to secure your data and business continuity.
cybersecurite.aboutDescription:
Faced with rising cyber threats, LaboGraphie offers complete cybersecurity solutions to protect your systems, your data and your business continuity. Our experts carry out thorough audits and penetration tests to identify vulnerabilities before they can be exploited.

We also support our clients in achieving compliance and implementing sound security practices day to day.
included: Complete audit of your systems, networks and applications
Application and network penetration testing carried out by our experts
Action plan and recommendations to strengthen your security
benefits: Better protection of your sensitive data and that of your customers
A significant reduction in the risk of cyberattacks
Stronger compliance with industry best practices
Ongoing support to maintain a high level of security

workSteps.title: Penetration Testing

formations-pro.title: Professional Training
formations-pro.description: Digital coaching programs and continuing education tailored to your teams: design, development, advanced office skills and cybersecurity.
formations-pro.aboutDescription:
LaboGraphie has been training Cameroonian students and professionals in digital careers for several years. Our programs cover design, development, advanced office skills and cybersecurity, with a hands-on, results-oriented approach.

Having trained over 500 students, we pride ourselves on passing on skills that are directly applicable in the job market.
included: A structured curriculum, adapted to participants' skill level
Experienced trainers and hands-on exercises based on real cases
Certificate of completion and post-training follow-up
benefits: Skills directly applicable in the professional world
Personalized support throughout the program
Expert trainers with real field experience
Flexible formats suited to individuals and businesses alike

maintenance-it.description: Technical support, network infrastructure and preventive maintenance to keep your IT fleet reliable, fast and always available.
maintenance-it.aboutDescription:
Our technical team handles maintenance and support for your IT fleet and network infrastructure. One-off interventions, monthly maintenance contracts or full network installation: we guarantee the reliability and availability of your systems.

Our goal is to reduce downtime and let you focus on your core business with peace of mind.
included: Fast diagnosis and troubleshooting of your IT equipment
Preventive maintenance and continuous monitoring of your infrastructure
Installation and configuration of reliable, secure networks
benefits: A significant reduction in breakdowns and business disruptions
Responsive technical support available in emergencies
A stable, high-performing network infrastructure
A single point of contact for your entire IT fleet
